Five lessons from migrating our monolith to AWS Lambda

By the Harborline platform team · October 2, 2026

Last year we moved our appointment reminder service from a single EC2 instance to AWS Lambda and DynamoDB. The migration took four months and taught us a lot about cold starts, idempotency and observability.

1. Start with the data model

DynamoDB rewards you for knowing your access patterns up front. We spent the first two weeks writing down every query the service made and designing keys around them.

2. Make every handler idempotent

Events can be delivered more than once. We added idempotency keys to every write so retries never sent a patient two reminders.

3. Invest in structured logs

CloudWatch Logs Insights is only as good as the logs you send it. We log JSON with a request ID on every line, which made incident reviews dramatically faster.
